title: Lootale Slash
summary: Lootale Slash is a pixel-art action MMORPG. Explore a shared world, choose from six classes, conquer dungeons and world bosses, hunt rare gear, and create a playstyle that is truly your own.
about:
Fight. Loot. Progress.

Lootale Slash is a pixel-art action MMORPG where every battle can reward you with the next item that changes your build.

Choose Berserker, Guardian, Hunter, Sniper, Mage, or Priest. Each class has its own mastery, skill tree, and passive, and you can customize how your character looks. Explore a persistent online world, meet other adventurers in real time, and walk between connected maps into more dangerous regions in search of powerful gear.

Build your own playstyle

Your strength comes from the choices you make. Combine weapons, armor, jewelry, artifacts, abilities, and pets to create a build that fits the way you want to play.

Gear has different levels and rarities. Enchant your best items with extra attributes, and fuse gear in pursuit of even more valuable rewards. Whether you prefer rapid attacks, high durability, critical damage, or frequent ability use, your character's progression is in your hands.

Explore a shared world

The world of Lootale Slash is inhabited by players and creatures in real time. Explore hunting grounds, join large group battles, and prepare for world bosses that can drop rare artifacts.

The maps are connected, so you can walk from one to another. Gather your party for co-op dungeons, watch for traps, defeat the boss, and claim the rewards before returning to the open world.

Classes, abilities, and progression

Each class has its own mastery, skill tree, and passive. Earn experience through combat, unlock new abilities, and invest skill points to expand your arsenal.

Abilities consume Arkanyx, a resource that regenerates during battle. Managing it, and choosing the right moment to attack, defend, or support your party, is part of combat.

More than combat

Gather resources throughout the world, develop professions, and brew potions through alchemy. Discover eggs, hatch new pets, and raise companions that follow you and provide their own benefits.

In town, meet NPCs, complete quests, enchant your equipment, organize your storage, and prepare for your next expedition.

A player-driven economy

Trade directly with other adventurers or list your discoveries on the marketplace. Weapons, armor, pets, materials, and consumables can circulate between players.

The interface is available in 10 languages.

Key features

Persistent shared online world, with maps you can walk between
Top-down action combat
Six classes, each with mastery, a skill tree, and a passive
Permanent gear with levels and rarities, plus enchanting and fusion
Co-op dungeons and world bosses
Pets, gathering professions, and alchemy
Quests and daily challenges
Parties, friends, chat, trading, and a marketplace
Visual customization
